what: the coolant plan's capacity probe (gate CAP)
rule: first 2 seeds of each of ('through', 'turn', 'wavy') from 12000000 with Pe >= 180 at n = 128

criteria.groups: trial hats, j1-3, j4-8, j9-15; adjoint the same; the particular field (9 in all)
criteria.statistic: per group, the median over the pieces of the error in the piece's diffusion norm over TL0's; the worst piece reported beside it
criteria.dead_stop: the loss above 0.95 at or after 20% of the steps ends the run (recorded as dead)
criteria.owner: the owner, in chat on 2026-11-19, before the first run: the bar 0.30 ("0.30 (Recommended)": CL-A needs about 0.44 on held-out layouts, with margin for the gap to training pieces); both forms at 1M, 3,000 steps each, 3M only if both fail ("Both forms, 3,000 steps (Recommended)"); on mains
criteria.runs: free-1M, then bubble-1M; 3M (the form that did better) only if both fail
